annotations.title: Say a month had no pay

description: Says months had no pay — between jobs, unpaid leave — so no paycheck is missing for them: Home stops asking "No paycheck for …" and `paychecks` stops listing them as gaps. `no_pay: false` takes it back. Stores the answer only; no paycheck and no figure. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first.

commit.description: Default false. False previews; true writes.

no_pay.description: Default true. False takes the answer back.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.
